Initial release: Instantly create and export AI-edited short video clips, no editing skills needed.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM clips up to 500MB for automatic AI-powered editing and export.
- Quickly trim footage, add transitions, and generate 30-second clips in under a minute.
- Free, anonymous access includes 100 credits (7-day expiry); no account required.
- Easy command-based interface for uploading, editing, and exporting 1080p MP4s—perfect for TikTok creators.
- Real-time session handling, robust error messages, and format support for most common video/audio/image types.
